notes: First live Tier III Uptime-certified open-access carrier-neutral DC in DRC; went live 13 Aug 2024 at SILIKIN Village, Concession COTEX, Avenue Colonel Mondjiba, Kinshasa (Ngaliema commune). ~1,000 m2 technical space, N+1 cooling, 2 MW site load (site load, not IT load), 22 kV supply with 11 kV distribution; initial 400 m2 IT white space, future 550+ racks. Also hosts KINIX/ACIX exchange nodes per PeeringDB/DE-CIX.
